targets.self_route_adjudication: CONTESTED, not adopted. The self-route is correct that R_STAR=2.45 is not the best operating point on these seeds and that H-IDIO (no rule anywhere) is refuted: r=2.65 grades 4/5 here and also graded 4/5 on 935's own seeds 42-46, so a single r replicates out of sample. (i) The run's STRICTER, substrate-specified reproducibility bar -- the >=2 ADJACENT swept values each mixed on >=2/3 of seeds bar that mode-governance-engagement's own failure_record names -- returns graded=false, regime_shape='mixed_not_reproducible', longest_adjacent_run=1. H-KNIFE is deliberately looser (one r suffices), so the re-queue recommendation rests on the relaxed bar while the pre-registered strict one says the opposite. (The original form of this ground -- that 4/5 is a structural POPULATION CEILING because ~1-in-5 seeds is un-gradeable at any cap -- was WITHDRAWN: see withdrawn_arguments W1.) (iii) substrate_hash_matches_v3_935 is FALSE. R_STAR=2.45 was derived on 935's substrate (921d0af6...) and tested on a different one (3984b01e...). four_layer_diagnosis.environment: partial. The curriculum produces agents whose external_task probability stream differs sharply in within-cell dispersion (p90 - p10 of the per-step operating_mode['external_task'] softmax value): seeds 47 (0.25-0.36) and 49 (0.23-0.35) versus 51 (0.027-0.041), 48 (0.008-0.012) and 50 (0.0000 at every one of its seven cells, identical to 4 dp). That bears on H4 (clip rather than divisive normalisation) rather than opening a new axis. Stated against the tempting over-read: saturation does NOT preclude grading -- 935's seeds 45 and 46 are equally saturated (R^2 0.9999, spreads 0.014-0.034) and graded at 2 and 3 r values respectively. 935a is a member of the frozen z_goal scaffold family (pinned 32 -> 33 by ree-v3 2f575a9209 for this very run), so goal state is inherited frozen into the eval clones and is a candidate contributor to the saturation; unproven here and NOT claimed.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: under-instrumented -- DOMINANT LAYER, three established defects plus one flagged observation. (0) FLAGGED, NOT DIAGNOSED -- the within-run dispersion correlation. Within this run the number of graded r values is perfectly rank-ordered by calibration-cell dispersion (seed 50: 0.0000 -> 0 graded r; 48: 0.0077 -> 1; 51: 0.0401 -> 3; 49: 0.2252 -> 4; 47: 0.2484 -> 5; Spearman rho = 1.000, n=5). It does NOT survive its first out-of-sample check: on 935's seeds 42-46 the same statistic gives rho = -0.05, while the BASELINE MEAN margin -- the quantity this autopsy was briefly minded to call the wrong moment -- orders those seeds at rho = -0.975. 935's seed 44 settles it directly: calibration-cell spread 0.0004 (more saturated than any 935a seed) yet 0.16-0.32 at the swept caps, and graded at 2 r values. So dispersion measured at CAP_REF is itself cap-dependent and is not a covariate this autopsy can route on. Recorded as a pre-registerable hypothesis for the zero-compute re-score leg, nothing more; the stronger form was WITHDRAWN (withdrawn_arguments W2). (2) THE GRADED PREDICATE IS OCCUPANCY-ONLY. _graded(occ) tests 0.1 < occ < 0.9 and nothing else; it does not require within-episode alternation -- and the quantity it reads is a LATCHED register, not a per-step argmax: salience_coordinator.py:517-523 updates current_mode only when salience_aggregate > enter_threshold AND current_mode_prob < exit_threshold AND soft_argmax != current_mode, so occupancy can be pinned by the AGGREGATE gate independently of the cap under test. At R_STAR the three 'graded' seeds carry 57, 59 and 24 switches over 15 episodes -- 47 and 49 are genuine alternation, 51 is barely above the known-vacuous n_switches == n_episodes = 15 signature this lineage was already burned by (2026-06-12 autopsy). MECH-266's hysteresis expresses in the ALTERNATION, not the time-average, so an occupancy-only predicate is not the right instrument for the claim the lineage is aiming at. (3) THE NON-DEGENERACY FLAG IS MIS-SCOPED. criteria_non_degenerate = {C1: base_non_degenerate, C2: base_non_degenerate}, where base_non_degenerate is a RUN-level readiness AND manipulation_landed conjunction. It is per-criterion in name only and certifies nothing about the cells that actually decided C1. This matters downstream: the frozen-ledger elimination bar reads manifest.criteria_non_degenerate directly. (4) POWER. MIN_FRACTION 2/3 on n=5 is '>= 4 of 5'. At the generalisation rate the pooled data actually supports for 2.45 (7/10 across both seed sets) that criterion passes with probability 0.53; even at 2.65's pooled 8/10 it passes with probability 0.74. A single FAIL at R_STAR is therefore weak evidence against the rule, and a single PASS would have been weak evidence for it.

learning_extracted: A criterion stated as a FRACTION can hide how coarse it is. MIN_FRACTION 2/3 on n=5 is '>= 4 of 5': the attainable values are 0/.2/.4/.6/.8/1.0 and the bar falls between two of them, so a single seed decides the verdict. At the generalisation rate the pooled two-set data actually supports, the criterion clears 53-74% of the time -- it cannot separate a rule that generalises at 0.7 from one that does not, in either direction. Power the bar for the test, and state it in seeds.

A control that is RECORDED but not CONSUMED is the defect this lineage keeps repeating. 935 was autopsied for computing H-KNIFE and routing past it. 935a fixed that, and then recorded substrate_hash_matches_v3_935 = FALSE -- its pre-registered constant was derived on a different substrate than it was tested on -- without that fact entering the routing or the self-route label. Making a fact auditable is progress over asserting it in prose; giving it a NAMED BRANCH in the verdict is the step still missing.

A per-criterion flag name should mean a per-criterion check. criteria_non_degenerate maps BOTH criteria to one run-level readiness conjunction; it certifies nothing about the cells that decided C1, and it is exactly the field the frozen-ledger elimination bar reads. Same family as the INFO_ONLY H-KNIFE defect: a control whose NAME promises more than its computation delivers.

An occupancy-only gradedness predicate is not an instrument for a hysteresis claim, and the register it reads is LATCHED. MECH-266 predicts an asymmetry between ENTERING and LEAVING a mode, which lives in the switch sequence; current_mode updates only on a three-way gate (aggregate above the enter rail, current-mode probability below the exit rail, argmax disagreeing), so occupancy can be pinned by the aggregate gate independently of the cap under test. Eight consecutive runs have been scored on occupancy while the claim's own observable is alternation asymmetry -- and in none of them was exit_thresholds ever set, so the Schmitt trigger was inert throughout.

A within-run correlation of rho = 1.000 on n=5 is a hypothesis, not a diagnosis -- and this autopsy is the case study. A perfect, mechanistically plausible ordering (dispersion vs graded-r count) survived drafting and died on its first out-of-sample check (rho = -0.05 on the predecessor's seeds, with a direct counterexample in 935's seed 44). Check a new covariate against the PREDECESSOR's banked seeds before routing on it; the data to do it was already on disk and the check cost minutes.

The upper edge of a window is worth measuring even when the lower edge looks clean. 935's autopsy asked for the sweep to be extended, and the extension is what showed the graded-count curve is PEAKED (0.4/0.6/0.8/0.4/0.4), not monotone as 935's restricted range suggested -- and that the in-sample two-point window (2.45 and 2.65 both 4/5 on 42-46) narrows to a single point out of sample (2.65 only). An elimination or a band earned inside a range should be re-read whenever the range grows.

required_changes: Run the zero-compute re-score FIRST (fanout probe 1). It costs nothing and it decides whether anything beyond a powered re-test is warranted.

Power the seed bar for the criterion actually used: >= 4-of-5 at a true rate of 0.7-0.8 clears only ~53-74% of the time. State the bar in seeds, not as a fraction that lands between two attainable values.

Replace the occupancy-only graded predicate with a conjunction: occupancy strictly inside (0.1, 0.9) AND per-cell n_switches strictly above the n_episodes vacuity floor, so a once-per-episode settle can never count as a mixed regime.

Scope criteria_non_degenerate per criterion, or rename it. Its consumers -- the frozen-ledger elimination bar among them -- read it as a per-criterion certificate and it is a run-level readiness conjunction.
Report the graded WINDOW WIDTH in r per seed, not the count of grid points hit; the count is grid-density-dependent, which is 935's own recorded lesson.

Consume substrate_hash_matches_<predecessor> in the ROUTING, not only in the manifest: a pre-registered constant inherited across a substrate move should force a recalibration branch rather than be scored as if its basis held.

Whenever the target is MECH-266 rather than the calibration upstream of it, instantiate an asymmetric-threshold arm. No run in this lineage has, and exit_thresholds is at its 1.0 no-op sentinel throughout this one.

withdrawn_arguments.why_withdrawn: Two of its three supports fail. (a) 935's seed 42 is not a second instance: its external_task probability VARIES (spreads 0.098-0.173) and 935's own confirmed autopsy already recorded its zero graded count as an untested-range fact, since 935's sweep stopped at 2.65. Only seed 50 is a pure step. (c) For seed 50 alone, 'structural' is not distinguishable from 'window narrower than the grid': its transition lies in the untested cap interval (0.988, 1.063). A confirmed elimination should not be relitigated on one seed and a false absolute -- and Step 9b's split row requires non_degenerate true, which this run's run-level flag cannot honestly supply. Kept as a recorded observation with no disposition (read_across item 1).

withdrawn_arguments.argument: That within-cell DISPERSION of the external_task probability, not the cap/mean ratio, governs whether a graded regime exists -- i.e. the rule normalises the wrong moment -- with a perfect rank correlation (rho = 1.000, n=5) as its basis, routed as a stratification requirement and a new ledger leg.
withdrawn_arguments.why_withdrawn: It fails its first out-of-sample check. On 935's seeds 42-46 the same statistic gives rho = -0.05, while the baseline MEAN margin -- the quantity the argument called the wrong moment -- orders those seeds at rho = -0.975. 935's seed 44 is a direct counterexample: calibration-cell spread 0.0004, yet 0.16-0.32 at the swept caps and graded at 2 r values, so dispersion measured at CAP_REF is itself cap-dependent and a stratification keyed on it would have misclassified that seed. A within-run rho of 1.000 on n=5 is a hypothesis, not a diagnosis. Retained as a flagged observation (four_layer measurement item 0) and as the declared null of the zero-compute re-score leg.
